title: Text Seat Step-Off and Texts CRITICAL, 14:45

fields.organization: Great Plains Crisis Network — 988 Operations Floor, Lincoln, NE
fields.formTitle: Floor Status and Staff Step-Off Report
fields.location: Operations floor, text and chat pod, seat T-05, and the raised supervisor desk
fields.summary: Fictional and de-identified. This report contains no contact content. At 14:43 I closed my last text and completed the full record, including the risk assessment block. At 14:44 I set my status to After Contact Work. At 14:45 I told Priyanka Venkat at the raised desk: "Pri, I need to step off. I grew up two miles from Ellery Ridge, and my cousin drives for that district. I've closed every contact properly and I'm not in trouble, but I'm not steady enough to take the next one." At the same moment the platform report on the desk screen showed TEXTS CRITICAL for 14:30–14:45, while the wall board still showed TEXTS WATCH. Marcus Oyelaran, at the second desk, said: "Oldest text is past 20 minutes on the platform. That's the Level 3 trigger. Somebody needs to get Dr. Wilhelmina Strand to declare it and open the executive command line now, not when the board catches up."

findings.notes: Closed at 14:43. Disposition and risk assessment block complete. No open contacts are assigned to seat T-05.

findings.item: Counselor ready to take the next contact
findings.notes: Personal connection to the Ellery Ridge area. Not steady enough to take another contact. This is not a conduct or documentation issue.
Offered 25, answered 19, abandoned 2, in queue 4. 17 answered within 120 s (68%). Status CRITICAL.
Still shows WATCH. Footer: 'Data interval 14:00–14:15'. The board is two intervals behind the platform.
The 6 trained admin staff have been on texts since 14:05. Seat T-05 is now empty and showing After Contact Work.

findings.item: State backup center shared text queue
findings.notes: Logins for the two backup center supervisors are still not confirmed. No texts are routed to them. No start time is logged.

findings.item: Call overflow to backup, ref NOC-26-03118
findings.notes: Live since 14:28 according to the network operations desk e-mail.

actionsTaken: Closed the last text at 14:43 and completed the full record
Set status to After Contact Work at 14:44 so that no new text routes to seat T-05
Told the surge commander, Priyanka Venkat, in person at the raised desk at 14:45
Left the headset at seat T-05 and stayed at the desk to wait for direction
recommendations: Cover seat T-05 on the text queue as soon as possible
The second desk reports that the Level 3 trigger is met on the platform (oldest text over 20 minutes) and that it needs to go to the Executive Director now
Follow up on the state backup center's logins to the shared text queue
Let me know where I should be and who I should talk to

instructorNote: This tests whether the DCO lets the counselor step off at once and offers the quiet room and a debrief, while the WFC fills seat T-05 with the next confirmed arrival. Also watch whether the SC takes the platform measure to the ED and the ED declares and logs Level 3 at 14:45, without waiting for the board to catch up. The ED should then open the executive command line with the DCO, COM and TM. Then check that the SC and TM follow up on the backup center's text logins and log a start time.
